heading: Mathematical Physics & Computational Engineering
summary: A five-layer map of the mathematics behind physical modelling and engineering software: 34 cards (4 / 8 / 7 / 8 / 7) that together cover all 67 knowledge-graph nodes, running top to bottom from macro mathematics through concrete methods, governing physics and numerical solvers to seven engineering domains. Hover or click any card to draw its full upstream and downstream dependency curves, or open the linked derivations, Python experiments, and knowledge graph.
note: Board labels are in Chinese. Mastery status is stored in this browser only and is shared with the full MPCE site.
